llm-experiments.name: llm-experiments
llm-experiments.description: Call LLMs for experiments testing theoretical predictions. Supports UF NaviGator (gpt-oss), DeepInfra (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Llama), OpenAI (GPT-5.x), Anthropic (Claude), and local OpenAI-compatible servers. Use for testing error rates, reasoning quality, decision-making under theory conditions.
